request.description: Verifies that the Express server is online and connected to MongoDB.
Fetches all event documents stored in the MongoDB collection using Event.find().

request.description: Creates a new event document in MongoDB using Event.create(). Returns 201 Created and newly assigned MongoDB ObjectId.

item.name: 4. GET - Retrieve Single Event by ID

request.description: Fetches a specific event from MongoDB by its 24-character hexadecimal ObjectId using Event.findById().

item.name: 5. PUT - Update Existing Event by ID

request.description: Updates fields of an existing event document in MongoDB using Event.findByIdAndUpdate().
Deletes an event document from MongoDB using Event.findByIdAndDelete().

item.name: 7. Error Handling - Invalid MongoDB ObjectId Format

request.description: Demonstrates error handling (400 Bad Request) when client supplies a malformed ID that is not a valid 24-character MongoDB ObjectId.
Demonstrates error handling (404 Not Found) when a validly formatted 24-char ObjectId is queried but does not exist in MongoDB.
Demonstrates error handling (400 Bad Request) when mandatory fields fail validation.
